column3: The Hebrew explicitly names the voice of supplications and the holy inner chamber; BSB says cry for mercy and sanctuary.
The Hebrew has their heart in the singular; BSB has hearts.
The Hebrew repeats give to them; BSB repeats repay them.
The Hebrew explicitly names the voice of supplications; BSB says cry for mercy.
The Hebrew describes trusting and rejoicing as completed and thanksgiving as future; BSB uses present verbs.
The Hebrew says strength to them without explicitly naming His people; salvations is plural.
